Chemical Wash: Sesuai untuk aircond yang bocor menitiskan air. Kami mencuci 'indoor coil' dan saluran paip buang air menggunakan pam tekanan tinggi.
Top-up & Tukar Gas: Mengukur dan menambah gas jenis R32, R410A, atau R22 agar suhu bilik anda kembali sejuk beku.
Pembaikan Kerosakan (Repair): Menyelesaikan masalah lampu timer berkelip, kipas luar tidak berpusing, dan penukaran 'capacitor' atau 'pcb board' yang rosak.

rows: Normal Service (Cuci Biasa)Mencuci penapis (filter), cover luar, dan membersihkan blower dari habuk.
Chemical Wash (Overhaul)Cucian mendalam menggunakan cecair kimia untuk mencairkan lendir (jelly block) dan mematikan bakteria.
Top Up Gas (R32 / R410A)Menambah tekanan gas pendingin untuk mengembalikan kesejukan maksimum unit anda.
Pemeriksaan & TroubleshootingMemeriksa punca kerosakan teknikal (spt. kapasitor rosak, air menitik, lampu berkelip).

pricing: Kami mengamalkan polisi harga yang sangat telus. Berikut adalah anggaran harga untuk perkhidmatan penyelenggaraan dan cucian penyaman udara (untuk Wall Mounted 1.0HP - 2.5HP) di sekitar Kuala Lumpur:
Pertama, hubungi kami melalui WhatsApp. Nyatakan masalah aircond anda (contoh: aircond tak sejuk, air menitik) dan kami akan memberikan anggaran sebut harga yang telus.

Harga kami sangat berpatutan bermula dari RM 60 ke RM 80 untuk cucian biasa (general service) bagi unit 1.0HP. Walau bagaimanapun, harga untuk chemical wash dan top-up gas bergantung pada saiz HP dan tahap kekurangan gas aircond anda.

orderedBlocks.summary: Does RK Reno accept small renovation jobs in KL?
orderedBlocks.text: Yes. Customers can request smaller scopes such as painting, tile repair, bathroom improvement, wall repair or selected maintenance work. Availability and minimum charges depend on location and job size.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does a basic condo refresh cost?
orderedBlocks.text: A limited cosmetic refresh may start around RM8,000. This is not a full-unit renovation. Final cost depends on unit size, painting, repairs, flooring, management rules and selected materials.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does painting one room cost?
orderedBlocks.text: A basic room repaint may start around RM400. Room size, wall condition, paint brand, coats and repair work affect the final quotation.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does bathroom renovation cost?
orderedBlocks.text: A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000, while an entry-level fuller renovation may start around RM6,000. Waterproofing, plumbing, tiles and sanitary fittings can increase the cost.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does a basic kitchen renovation cost?
orderedBlocks.text: An entry-level kitchen renovation may start around RM15,000. Cabinet length, countertop, appliances, plumbing, tiling and hacking affect the final price.

orderedBlocks.summary: Do condo renovations require management approval?
orderedBlocks.text: Many condos require renovation forms, contractor registration, deposits, lift protection and compliance with approved working hours. Customers should confirm the building rules before work begins.

orderedBlocks.summary: Do structural changes require approval?
orderedBlocks.text: Some extensions, structural changes and major alterations may require drawings or approval from the relevant authority. Requirements depend on the property and work scope.

orderedBlocks.summary: Can I get an initial estimate without a site visit?
orderedBlocks.text: An initial estimate may be possible using clear photos, videos, measurements, location and a detailed work list. A site review may still be required before confirming the final quotation.

orderedBlocks.summary: What should be included in the quotation?
orderedBlocks.text: The quotation should identify the work scope, materials, quantities, exclusions, disposal, payment stages, repair responsibilities and possible additional charges.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does office renovation cost in Kuala Lumpur?
orderedBlocks.text: A light office refresh may start around RM30 per sq ft, while a basic fit-out may start around RM50 per sq ft. These are planning figures only. Partitions, electrical work, data cabling, furniture, aircond, building rules and material choices affect the final quotation.

orderedBlocks.summary: How much does office reinstatement cost?
orderedBlocks.text: A basic reinstatement may start around RM20 per sq ft. The lease, landlord checklist, existing tenant improvements, hacking, disposal and final inspection requirements can increase the cost.

orderedBlocks.summary: Can RK Reno handle a small office refresh?
orderedBlocks.text: Small offices may request selected painting, flooring, lighting or partition work. Availability and minimum charges depend on the building location and actual scope.

orderedBlocks.summary: What should I send for an initial quote?
orderedBlocks.text: Send the building name, location, floor area, floor plan, existing photos, required rooms, workstations, services and expected budget range.

orderedBlocks.summary: Does an office renovation require management approval?
orderedBlocks.text: Many commercial buildings require renovation applications, deposits, contractor information, access arrangements and compliance with approved working hours. Confirm the specific building rules before work starts.

orderedBlocks.summary: Can work be done outside normal office hours?
orderedBlocks.text: The possible work schedule depends on the building's approved hours, the type of work and team availability. Do not assume night or weekend work is allowed until management approval is confirmed.

orderedBlocks.summary: What is included in office reinstatement?
orderedBlocks.text: The scope may include removing partitions, flooring, ceiling items, wiring or tenant fixtures and repairing or repainting retained surfaces. The landlord's handover checklist should define the final scope.

orderedBlocks.summary: How should I compare office renovation quotations?
orderedBlocks.text: Compare the same layout, quantities, material specifications, electrical and data scope, disposal, protection, exclusions and payment stages. A lower total may exclude important work.

We visit your site to take exact measurements. We discuss your aesthetic preferences and coordinate the required drop height to accommodate electrical wiring and aircond piping.

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of renovating a retail shop in KL typically ranges from RM 120 to RM 250+ per square foot. This varies based on the quality of custom carpentry, lighting design, and the strictness of mall management requirements.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We have extensive experience dealing with premium mall managements in KL. We assist in submitting the necessary architectural, structural, and M&E drawings to ensure full fire safety (Bomba) and building compliance.

mainEntity.name: Can your team work at night?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely. Most shopping malls in Kuala Lumpur restrict noisy works and material loading to after-hours (usually 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM). Our commercial renovation teams are fully prepared for night-shift execution.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide shop reinstatement services when my lease ends?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, we offer fast and efficient commercial reinstatement services. We will hack down partitions, remove flooring, and restore the unit to its original bare condition so you can secure your full tenancy deposit.

mainEntity.name: Can you fix a bathroom leak without hacking the tiles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We offer no-hack solutions using PU Injection from the ceiling below, or applying a clear, penetrative Nano-coating over the existing tiles to seal the grout lines.

mainEntity.name: How much does PU Injection cost in Kuala Lumpur?

acceptedAnswer.text: PU Injection is charged per injection point, typically ranging from RM 150 to RM 300 per point, depending on the severity of the crack and accessibility.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide a warranty for waterproofing work?

mainEntity.name: What is Torch-On Membrane?

orderedBlocks.text: Inter-Floor Leaks (Bathrooms)
orderedBlocks.html: Inter-Floor Leaks (Bathrooms)

orderedBlocks.text: If you live in a condo or a double-storey house, a dripping plaster ceiling is usually caused by the bathroom directly above it. The original waterproof membrane beneath the bathroom tiles has degraded, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.

orderedBlocks.text: RC Flat Roofs & Balconies
orderedBlocks.html: RC Flat Roofs & Balconies

orderedBlocks.text: Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through.
orderedBlocks.html: Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through.

orderedBlocks.text: External Wall Seepage
orderedBlocks.html: External Wall Seepage

orderedBlocks.text: Heavy driving rain can penetrate porous brick walls or degraded exterior paint, causing the paint on your interior walls to bubble, peel, or grow mold.

orderedBlocks.text: 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hacking Required)

orderedBlocks.text: In the past, fixing a leaking ceiling meant your contractor had to hack up the entire bathroom floor above it, re-apply cement, and lay new tiles. It was expensive, loud, and took weeks.
orderedBlocks.html: In the past, fixing a leaking ceiling meant your contractor had to hack up the entire bathroom floor above it, re-apply cement, and lay new tiles. It was expensive, loud, and took weeks.

orderedBlocks.text: Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection.
orderedBlocks.html: Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection.

orderedBlocks.text: We drill small holes into the concrete slab where the leak is occurring. Using a high-pressure pump, we inject liquid polyurethane resin into the cracks. When the resin meets the trapped water inside the concrete, it reacts instantly—expanding up to 30 times its volume to form a tough, waterproof rubber seal that permanently blocks the water path.

orderedBlocks.html: 3. Torch-On Membrane for Flat Roofs

orderedBlocks.text: For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays.
orderedBlocks.html: For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays.

orderedBlocks.text: We use Torch-On Bituminous Membrane. This involves rolling out sheets of modified asphalt (bitumen) reinforced with polyester. 2. The Magic of PU Injection (No-Hacking Required)

paragraphs: Water leakage is an insidious problem. It starts as a small yellow stain on your ceiling or peeling paint on a wall. Ignored for too long, it rots wooden structures, rusts steel beams, and causes toxic black mold to spread through your home.

In Malaysia's torrential monsoon climate, the integrity of your roof and bathrooms is constantly tested. Finding a reliable Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur is critical because improper fixes—like just slapping a coat of silicone over a crack—will fail within months.
At RK Reno Solution, we don't just patch leaks; we cure them. From modern PU injection to heavy-duty torch-on membranes, this guide explains how we permanently protect your property.
Before applying any waterproofing material, we must identify the source. Here are the three most common leakage points we encounter in Kuala Lumpur:

If you live in a condo or a double-storey house, a dripping plaster ceiling is usually caused by the bathroom directly above it. The original waterproof membrane beneath the bathroom tiles has degraded, allowing water to seep into the concrete slab.
Reinforced Concrete (RC) roofs are prone to cracking due to thermal expansion (the extreme heat of the KL sun followed by cold rain). Water pools in these cracks and eventually seeps through.
Heavy driving rain can penetrate porous brick walls or degraded exterior paint, causing the paint on your interior walls to bubble, peel, or grow mold.
In the past, fixing a leaking ceiling meant your contractor had to hack up the entire bathroom floor above it, re-apply cement, and lay new tiles. It was expensive, loud, and took weeks.
Today, as a modern Waterproofing Contractor Kuala Lumpur, our go-to solution for concrete slab leaks is Polyurethane (PU) Injection.

We drill small holes into the concrete slab where the leak is occurring. Using a high-pressure pump, we inject liquid polyurethane resin into the cracks. When the resin meets the trapped water inside the concrete, it reacts instantly—expanding up to 30 times its volume to form a tough, waterproof rubber seal that permanently blocks the water path.
For large exposed areas like RC flat roofs or commercial gutters, PU injection is not enough. The surface needs a heavy-duty shield against standing water and UV rays.

We use Torch-On Bituminous Membrane. This involves rolling out sheets of modified asphalt (bitumen) reinforced with polyester. We use a blowtorch to melt the underside of the sheet, fusing it directly to the concrete. This creates an impenetrable, flexible layer that can withstand structural movements and severe weather.
Don't wait for it to collapse. Get a professional leak assessment today.
We do not guess where the water is coming from. Our systematic approach ensures we fix the root cause.

acceptedAnswer.text: Standard gypsum board is not waterproof. Therefore, for bathrooms, kitchens, or areas with high humidity, we strictly recommend using moisture-resistant plasterboards (often green in color) to prevent mold and sagging.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to rewire a house in Selangor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Rewiring costs depend on property size. A standard single-storey terrace house usually starts from RM 3,000 to RM 5,000, while double-storey homes can range from RM 5,000 to RM 10,000 depending on the number of points.

mainEntity.name: Do I need 3-phase power for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need 3-phase power if you have 4 or more air conditioners (especially 2.0HP units), multiple instant water heaters, or an EV car charger. Single-phase is usually sufficient for small apartments.

mainEntity.name: What causes frequent power trips?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frequent tripping is usually caused by an overloaded circuit (too many appliances on one plug), a faulty appliance causing a short, or damaged wiring insulation allowing current to leak to earth.

paragraphs: House renovation costs in Kuala Lumpur can start with a few hundred ringgit for one small room and rise substantially for kitchens, bathrooms, full-condo work or structural changes. The safest way to plan is to define the exact scope, separate essential work from optional finishes and request an itemised quotation.

This guide provides low-entry starting estimates for painting, tiling, bathroom work, kitchen renovation and basic home refreshes. The figures are intended for early budget planning. They are not fixed packages because property condition, materials, access, hacking, disposal and building rules can change the final cost.
For contractor services rather than general cost information, visit the House Renovation in Kuala Lumpur service page or the House Renovation in Selangor page.
Send your location, property type, photos, measurements and required work through WhatsApp.
There is no single price for a house renovation because the word “renovation” can mean anything from repainting one room to rebuilding kitchens, bathrooms, electrical systems and internal layouts.

A small room refresh may begin from a few hundred ringgit. A limited bathroom refresh may start around RM3,000. A basic cosmetic condo or home refresh may start around RM8,000. Kitchens, full bathrooms, extensive hacking, new layouts and structural work require a larger measured quotation.

Use these figures to decide whether your current budget matches a small repair, a room upgrade or a broader renovation. Do not treat a starting price as the final cost before the property and work scope have been reviewed.
Start by deciding how much of the property you actually need to change. Reducing the scope is usually more effective than choosing the cheapest material for every item.
Suitable for a basic room repaint, selected wall repair, small fixture replacement or another clearly limited task.
May cover selected painting, minor repairs or simple improvements. It does not mean a complete-property renovation.
Required for major hacking, layout changes, extensions, full rewiring, roofing, several bathrooms or complete-property work.
One quotation may include hacking, disposal, waterproofing, wiring and materials while another includes labour only. A lower total does not always mean a lower price for the same work.
The figures below use low-entry estimates to help customers start a conversation. Final quotations must be based on actual measurement and specifications.
These prices represent different scopes. For example, a RM3,000 bathroom refresh is not the same work as a RM6,000 basic bathroom renovation. Ask for the exact inclusions before comparing prices.
The examples below are not packages or promises. They show how project priorities may change at different budget levels.
Usually best for one clearly defined task, such as painting a room, selected wall repairs, minor tile work, fitting replacement or a limited bathroom refresh.
May cover a cosmetic home refresh, a more complete bathroom scope, selected flooring or a limited kitchen refresh, depending on materials and property condition.
May support a basic kitchen renovation, several cosmetic upgrades or a combination of selected rooms. Hacking and premium materials can reduce the amount covered.
Can be used for broader multi-room work, but complete-condo or landed-house renovations may require substantially more depending on scope and finishes.
Condo work may involve management approval, renovation deposits, restricted work hours, lift bookings, delivery procedures, floor protection and controlled debris removal.
Landed homes may allow more access, but extensions, roof changes, new walls and structural alterations can require plans, engineering input or approval from the relevant authority.
Completing work in the wrong order can damage finished surfaces and create unnecessary rework.
Confirm scope, measurements, property rules, drawings and any required approval before physical work begins.
Protect retained surfaces, remove approved items and arrange safe debris collection.
Complete concealed piping, wiring, wall changes, waterproofing and related preparation before closing surfaces.
Complete plaster ceiling, tile work, levelling and flooring according to the agreed sequence.
Install cabinets and fixtures, complete finishing paint and protect newly completed work.
Test electrical, plumbing, drainage and other systems, then record and correct remaining defects.
A useful renovation budget includes more than the visible finishes.
Older homes and wet areas can reveal hidden damage only after tiles, ceilings or cabinets are removed. Keep part of the budget uncommitted until the risky areas have been inspected.
Ask each contractor to quote the same work and specifications. Otherwise, the totals cannot be compared fairly.

Send the property location, type, room photos, short videos, approximate measurements, preferred finish, building rules and expected budget range. Better information usually produces a more useful initial estimate.
Minor cosmetic work and structural alterations should not be treated the same. Approval requirements depend on the property, building management, work type and relevant authority.

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard single-storey kitchen extension for a terrace house in Selangor typically costs between RM 45,000 to RM 70,000. This includes piling, brickworks, roofing, and tiling.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit for renovation in Subang Jaya (MBSJ)?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, MBSJ requires a permit for any renovation involving structural changes, such as extensions, removing columns, or changing the roof. Minor internal works like painting usually do not require a permit.

paragraphs: Selangor is home to some of the most vibrant townships in Malaysia. From the bustling streets of Subang Jaya to the spacious layouts of Shah Alam and the growing communities in Cyberjaya, renovating a home here offers incredible potential.

However, managing a House Renovation in Selangor is vastly different from Kuala Lumpur. Each local council (Majlis) has its own set of strict bylaws regarding setbacks, extensions, and rubbish disposal. Without local knowledge, your dream project can stall indefinitely.
At RK Reno Solution, we have over 10 years of experience navigating these waters. This guide covers everything from council approvals to cost breakdowns for 2026.
Unlike KL which is centralized under DBKL, Selangor is divided into various municipalities. Knowing which one you fall under is the first step to a legal renovation.
We provide a "Turnkey Solution," meaning we handle the dirty work, the technical wiring, and the fine finishing. You deal with one project manager, not ten different contractors.

The final touches that make a house a home. This includes plaster ceilings with L-box lighting, 2x2 porcelain tiling, and weather-resistant exterior painting.
How do we turn a bare unit into a showroom? Here is our proven workflow.
We visit your site in Selangor to measure dimensions and inspect structural integrity (beams, columns, roof condition). We listen to your needs—do you need a wet kitchen? An extra bedroom?
We provide a transparent, itemized quote. We advise on material costs: Ceramic vs Porcelain tiles, Laminate vs Vinyl flooring.
Once the deposit is paid and permits (if needed) are secured, work begins. We manage the "RORO bin" for debris removal to keep your neighbors happy.
We conduct a joint inspection to ensure all defects are rectified before the final handover.

acceptedAnswer.text: Harga anggaran bermula sekitar RM250 untuk rumah kecil atau kondo. Harga sebenar bergantung kepada saiz rumah, keadaan rumah, lokasi dan jenis cucian yang diperlukan.

mainEntity.name: How long does PU Injection take to dry?

acceptedAnswer.text: Polyurethane resin reacts incredibly fast. It begins to foam and expand within seconds of contacting water, and fully cures (hardens) within 15 to 30 minutes. The entire repair process usually takes just a few hours.

mainEntity.name: How much does PU injection waterproofing cost in KL?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of PU injection in Kuala Lumpur typically ranges from RM 150 to RM 300 per injection point. The total cost depends on the length of the crack and the number of injection packers required to seal it.

mainEntity.name: Is PU injection permanent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, PU injection is considered a highly durable and permanent fix. The cured polyurethane foam is flexible, meaning it can withstand minor structural movements without breaking the waterproof seal.

mainEntity.name: Do I have to hack my bathroom tiles for PU injection?

acceptedAnswer.text: No! That is the biggest benefit of PU injection. The injection is usually performed from the ceiling below the leaking bathroom. It requires zero hacking of your bathroom floor tiles, saving you time, money, and mess.

Liquid polyurethane resin is injected directly into the concrete crack using a high-pressure pump. The magic happens when this resin comes into contact with the water trapped inside the wall. It reacts instantly, expanding up to 30 times its original volume to form a dense, tough, waterproof foam. This foam perfectly fills every microscopic void, permanently sealing the water's path.

paragraphs: Keep your home spotless with RK Reno Solution. We provide professional Servis Cuci Rumah KL, including move-in cleaning, post-renovation cleaning, and spring cleaning.

Keeping a clean home in the busy city of Kuala Lumpur is a challenge. However, whether you need a deep clean after a house renovation or just a regular weekly tidying up, finding a reliable cleaner is crucial. RK Reno Solution is your trusted provider for Servis Cuci Rumah KL.

We are not just a maid agency; we are cleaning specialists. Therefore, our team is trained in deep cleaning techniques. We ensure every corner from ceiling fans to floor tiles is spotless. We provide Servis Cuci Rumah KL for residential condos, terrace houses, and commercial offices in Kuala Lumpur.

Unlike basic sweeping and mopping, our Deep Cleaning package involves scrubbing bathrooms, degreasing kitchens, and wiping down all surfaces. Consequently, this removes stubborn dust and bacteria effectively.
We offer flexible packages to suit your specific needs:
First, contact us to book a slot. Tell us your house size and the type of Servis Cuci Rumah KL needed.
Next, our team arrives with all necessary equipment. We bring vacuums, detergents, and ladders so you don't need to provide anything.
Then, we clean systematically. We start from high areas down to the floors to ensure no dust remains.
Finally, we invite you to inspect the house. If you spot any missed areas, we reclean them immediately before leaving.
